title: Investigating nanotoxicity: uncovering associations and predictive factors through machine learning analysis of published literature
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,3158-3172
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00814F, Paper
Monrudee Liangruksa, Phurinat Udomsopagit, Khattaman Sriratanophast, Phawat Charoenwong, Purin Kanjanakumnerd, Teeraphan Laomettachit, Surat Teerapittayanon
The study applies machine learning, including supervised learning and association rule mining, to analyze nanotoxicity data. It reveals key associations and predictive factors, supporting safer nanomaterial design and risk assessment.
